headline: Contracts with Growing Friendship, Mass Insight, Branching Minds, and C3 Wellbeing, plus FY25 audit and virtual instruction day plans.
summary: The meeting covers four contracts and a Growing Friendship agreement. It also covers the FY25 audit, teacher assistant hiring, and staffing vacancy reports.
items: Public participation
Recognition of Paul Abbott
Slater Middle School monthly progress report
Tolman High School NEASC
CSI transformation updates for Tolman High, Shea High, Jenks Junior High, Fallon Elementary, and Cunningham Elementary schools
FY25 audit presentation
Absentee rate for Local 1352 members
Update on teacher assistant hiring and training
Vacancy and coverage report for teaching assistants, speech therapist, occupational therapist, and special education teachers
Winters Elementary social emotional learning (SEL) classrooms update
Update on student absentee data access
Growing Friendship MOU
Virtual instruction day plans
Tolman Mass Insight contract
Branching Minds contract approval
C3 Wellbeing EAP services contract
First passage of template administrator contract for principals and assistant principals
First passage of revision of Policy BEDB
Subcommittee updates: building, facilities, finance, policy, special education, and wellness
Reports: budget transfer, departmental overtime, enrollment, monthly distribution, vacancy, and work order
location: Pawtucket School Department Administration Building, 286 Main Street, Pawtucket, Rhode Island 02860
